open.objective_prompt: Chat about their day like a friend: react to one specific thing they said and ask one easy follow-up. Complete after two back-and-forths about their day or life right now.
Ease from the small talk into what they are working toward right now, and use the save_goal tool with their own words. Complete once save_goal has been used for at least one goal.

Find how they take things in, using the bank's S or N, P01 or P02, and P03 or P04 questions tied to their own stories: going off what has worked before (Si), what is right in front of them (Se), one clear endgame (Ni), or many possibilities (Ne). Ask for real moments. On a mixed answer, never ask the same question again in any wording: ask yes-or-no questions built from their own example, each narrower than the last, until one lands clearly, then say your read out loud and move on. Complete once one of the four is your best read.

Find how they decide, using the bank's P05 or P06 and P07 or P08 questions tied to their own stories: their own logic (Ti), what works and the facts (Te), their own sense of right (Fi), or what keeps the people around them okay (Fe). Ask for a real decision that mattered. On a mixed answer, never ask the same question again in any wording: ask yes-or-no questions built from their own example, each narrower than the last, until one lands clearly, then say your read out loud and move on. Complete once one of the four is your best read.
Ask the bank's P09 or P10 question once: does their view hold steady inside them or update from what others say? Complete after their answer.
Ask what drains them fastest, then what recharges them fastest. Complete after both answers.
Ask the bank's P11 and P12 questions: the thought that keeps coming back and the drive behind their decisions. Complete after two answers.
Catch up on their life with two or three casual questions: where they are based and what they do, who is around them, a moment that stuck with them. Complete after three answers.

Say you are putting it all together and use the synthesize_profile tool once, then hear their answer to the result and walk the rundown in one short turn before a warm bye. Complete once synthesize_profile has been used.

speed.objective_prompt: The greeting asked what they are working toward: use the save_goal tool with their own words. Complete once save_goal has been used.

Speed round: ask the bank questions in order, one quick either-or each with at most one probe, then use the synthesize_profile tool when the bank is done or a time check arrives. Complete once synthesize_profile has been used.
